Smukły wieszak kołkowy na okrągłej podstawie. Zajmuje bardzo mało miejsca, dlatego sprawdza się w małych gabinetach, przy wejściu i w wąskich korytarzach.

TerminStandardowo 15–20 dni roboczych. Dokładny termin podajemy w dniu złożenia zapytania lub zamówienia.

What are the dimensions of Clip?+
The base is 345 mm in diameter and the height is 1750 mm. Weight 7.5 kg.
What colours is it available in?+
In five: light grey RAL 7044, brick red RAL 0404040, black RAL 9005, blue RAL 5003 and yellow RAL 0807060.
Are there 3D models for the project?+
Yes, the manufacturer provides models in DWG, 3DS and SKP formats.
Which room does it suit best?+
Where space is tight: a small office, an entrance, a corridor. The base takes up only 345 mm.
Are assembly instructions included?+
Yes, the manufacturer provides assembly instructions in PDF as well as safe-use guidelines.
What is Clip made of?+
Of powder-coated metal. The round base is 345 mm in diameter.
